title.value: From YouTube to the brain: Transfer learning can improve brain-imaging predictions with deep learning
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the paper, indicating the focus on transfer learning to improve brain-imaging predictions using deep learning.
title.quote: From YouTube to the brain: Transfer learning can improve brain-imaging predictions with deep learning

analysis.description: The paper explores how transfer learning techniques can enhance predictions in brain imaging using deep learning models, particularly focusing on the application of 2D and 3D ResNet-18 models pretrained on large datasets such as YouTube (Kinetics) and ImageNet to predict various phenotypes from brain images in the UK Biobank dataset.

type.justification: The paper involves practical experimentation with transfer learning techniques applied to brain imaging data, using large datasets and models such as ResNet-18. It discusses the implementation and outcomes of these techniques.
type.quote: In this study, we translate state-of-the-art transfer learning techniques for single-subject prediction of simpler (sex and age) and more complex phenotypes...

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is the application of transfer learning techniques to improve brain imaging predictions using deep learning models.
name.quote: From YouTube to the brain: Transfer learning can improve brain-imaging predictions with deep learning

name.justification: The paper applies deep learning and transfer learning techniques to the field of brain imaging, which falls under imaging neuroscience.
name.quote: Transfer learning from previously learned knowledge based on real-world images and videos could unlock the potential in many areas of imaging neuroscience...

name.justification: The paper discusses the use of deep learning models, specifically convolutional neural networks, in the context of brain imaging and transfer learning.
name.quote: Deep learning has recently achieved best-in-class performance in several fields, including biomedical domains such as X-ray images.

name.justification: The paper specifically mentions fine-tuning 2D ResNet-18 models for phenotype predictions in brain imaging.
name.quote: We fine-tuned 2D and 3D ResNet-18 convolutional neural networks for target phenotype predictions from brain images...

is_contributed.justification: The ResNet-18 models were used but not developed or contributed as new in this paper. They are pretrained models applied to brain imaging tasks.
is_contributed.quote: We fine-tuned 2D and 3D ResNet-18 convolutional neural networks for target phenotype predictions...

is_executed.justification: The 2D ResNet-18 model was executed as part of the paper's experiments for transfer learning.
is_executed.quote: We fine-tuned 2D and 3D ResNet-18 convolutional neural networks for target phenotype predictions...

is_compared.justification: The model performance using transfer learning is compared to models trained from scratch to demonstrate its effectiveness.
is_compared.quote: Transfer learning in particular outperformed deep learning models trained from scratch especially on smaller sample sizes.
